text:
Sebastian Aho is having the kind of season that doesn't need defending. Nine goals on 8.3 expected, 23 points in 18 games, and nothing in his profile that screams luck. The defending champions own 60% of the five-on-five expected goals with him on the ice, and they've won seven of their last ten.

The headlines this week were historical. Yahoo Sports and Heavy both reported that he has passed Eric Staal in two major franchise categories, rare company for a second-round pick from 2015. Cory Lavalette of the North State Journal also flagged that Aho is a top-15 faceoff man this season, a part of his game that rarely gets mentioned.

One honest note: Carolina is good with almost everyone on the ice, so his edge over his teammates is smaller than his raw share suggests. Evolving-Hockey rated him 16th among forwards in 2025-26 and pointed out that strong linemates flatter his raw totals. Our projection lands near 93 points. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking gives you the thing to watch: he shoots a lot, but fewer of those attempts come from the slot than the volume suggests.
headline: The champion nobody needs to explain
